hero.intro: Discover the ingredients behind Biogance care — selected for their quality, their purpose and the benefits they bring to your companion's everyday routine.

editorial.paragraph1: Every formula begins with ingredient selection. At Biogance, botanical extracts, minerals and functional actives are chosen according to the care need, then incorporated at the right concentration to create effective, well-balanced formulas.
editorial.paragraph2: Explore the ingredient library to understand where each active comes from, what it brings to the formula and the types of care in which it is used.
